title: Mumbai local train stabbing death linked to gate dispute
summary: A fatal stabbing occurred on a Mumbai local train during an argument over keeping the door open in heavy rain. The suspect fled before the train stopped, and witnesses claim they stood by while watching.
summary_points: The incident happened between Andheri and Borivali stations on a first-class coach of the Fast Local.
